title: Word Break II
description_md:
Given a string `s` and a dictionary `wordDict`, return all possible sentences
(space-separated, in any order -- grading here ignores order) formed by breaking `s` into a sequence of
dictionary words. Use memoization; the naive version times out on longer inputs.

test_cases.explanation: 'catsanddog' can be fully broken into dictionary words two different ways: 'cat' + 'sand' + 'dog', or 'cats' + 'and' + 'dog'. Both use only words from wordDict and together account for every character in s, so both are valid sentences.
